articles.title: Mammoth, Avalanche stoke rivalry ahead of Winter Classic
PREVIEW: Ducks Continue Road Trip With Matchup Against Avalanche
Ducks Recall Defenseman Solberg from San Diego

out.detail: upper body injury; placed on injured reserve Saturday

away.summary: The Ducks (11-11-1) are 1-2 on their current road trip after an 8-6 loss to St. Louis on Tuesday and a 4-0 loss at Colorado on Thursday. Cutter Gauthier has been dominant in November, scoring 17 goals in nine games including four hat tricks. The lineup sees several changes with Sennecke on IR, Myatovic recalled from San Diego, and Solberg in the projected defense corps; Tyson Hinds, Noah Warren, and Nico Myatovic are listed as scratched.

home.summary: The Mammoth (11-9-3) come off a 4-1 win over Colorado on Wednesday, a physical game that stoked a budding rivalry. Coach Andre Tourigny said there will be game-time lineup decisions among the forward group, and Gregor Biber was recalled from Tucson on Saturday. Ben McCartney, Gregor Biber, and Artem Duda are listed as scratched for this game.
